title: Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6)
refreshHint: The state is read from the data plane on demand (and every 30 s).
proxyNote: Service-chaining proxies (End.AD, End.AM, End.AS) are not available: VPP 26.06 offers them only on its command line, without an API. SRv6-mobile and uSID are not supported either.

sids.title: Local SIDs
sids.sidHint: An IPv6 address; it is saved in canonical form (lower case, shortest ::)
sids.taken: This address is already a local SID or a binding SID

policies.title: Policies
policies.bsidHint: An IPv6 address; it is saved in canonical form (lower case, shortest ::)
policies.taken: This address is already a binding SID or a local SID
policies.inUse: Steering entries point at this policy: delete them first

globals.title: Encapsulation settings (VPP-wide)
globals.note: These two settings apply to the whole VPP and only the globals owner (the product agent) applies them. VPP cannot report them back, so they never show up as live state or drift. Every encapsulating policy uses its own source, or this one.

problem.noList: A policy needs at least one segment list.
problem.empty: A segment list needs at least one SID.
problem.tooMany: A segment list holds at most {{max}} SIDs.
problem.badSid: Every segment must be an IPv6 address.

steering.title: Steering
steering.empty: No traffic is steered into a policy.
steering.prefixHint: IPv4 or IPv6 network, e.g. 10.4.100.0/24; IPv4 needs an encapsulating policy
steering.l2Hint: VPP switches the interface to L2 cross-connect mode: it must not carry IP addresses
steering.duplicate: This prefix or interface is already steered.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.help: end: endpoint · end.x: endpoint with L3 cross-connect · end.t: table lookup · end.dx2/dx4/dx6: decapsulate and cross-connect · end.dt4/dt6: decapsulate and look up in a VRF

vrf.title: VRF
vrf.help: The IPv6 table the SID is installed in

interface.title: Interface
interface.help: end.x, end.dx2, end.dx4, end.dx6: the interface to cross-connect to

nextHop.title: Next hop
nextHop.help: end.x and end.dx6: IPv6; end.dx4: IPv4

lookupVrf.title: Lookup VRF
lookupVrf.help: end.t and end.dt6: the IPv6 table; end.dt4: the IPv4 table

type.title: Type
type.help: default: share the traffic over the segment lists by weight · spray: a copy on every list · tef: traffic engineering

encap.title: Encapsulate (H.Encaps)
encap.help: On: outer IPv6 header with the SRH (IPv4, IPv6 and L2 traffic). Off: the SRH is inserted into IPv6 traffic

vrf.title: VRF
vrf.help: The IPv6 table the binding SID is installed in

encapSource.title: Encapsulation source
encapSource.help: Outer source address of this policy (encapsulating policies only); empty = the VPP-wide setting

encapSource.title: Encapsulation source
encapSource.help: Outer source of encapsulating policies that set none, and VPP’s global default

encapHopLimit.title: Encapsulation hop limit
encapHopLimit.help: Hop limit of the outer IPv6 header, 1–255 (VPP default 64)
